_comment: Real GA (Address) table and Association table MemExtWrite ops captured via tshark during a genuine ETS Full Download to 1.1.10, AFTER real project GAs were renumbered to non-degenerate values - see 1.1.9's sibling fixture for full context. This device's first download attempt failed (aborted right after IndAddrSerNumRead/DevDescrRead, before any memory writes - see frames ~13034-13039 in the pcap); this fixture is from the successful second attempt only. Source: ga_wire_format_test.pcapng, frames 517/518 (Address table) and 505/506 (Association table).

gaTable.note: Matches real ETS group-address tree: 1/2/1 'Ch1 - SW' and 1/2/2 'Ch1 - FB' under '1 Functions > 1/2 Lighting' - sensible for this device (LED dimming actuator, channel 1 switch + feedback).

associationTable.note: Byte-identical to the earlier degenerate-GA capture, same reasoning as 1.1.9's fixture - association entries reference GA-table position, not value.
